description: This file defines a Tooltip class for Bootstrap v2.0.4, implementing tooltip functionality with methods for showing, hiding, positioning, and configuring tooltips, along with jQuery plugin integration.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class implementing tooltip behavior for Bootstrap components.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tooltip with specified type, element, and options.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges default options with user-provided options and data attributes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focus events to show the tooltip with delay.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or blur events to hide the tooltip with delay.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip, positioning it based on placement options.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and removes the tooltip with optional transition animation.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content based on the title.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip title from attributes or options.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the tooltip has content to display.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position for the tooltip.

methods.name: fixTitle
methods.description: Removes the title attribute to prevent default browser tooltips.
